name: AI Builder
description: Minimal AI panel in the editor: builds gameplay and decoration through a local CLI bridge.

object-limit.name: Object limit
object-limit.description: Maximum objects per generation. 0 = unlimited; large jobs are applied in batches.

bridge-url.name: Bridge URL
bridge-url.description: Phone companion: http://127.0.0.1:8765. Or use a PC bridge on your Wi-Fi.

object-policy.name: Object library
object-policy.description: All known GD IDs or the compact starter set.

model.name: AI model
model.description: Empty = CLI default. Use Model in the AI panel for account models.

account-actions.name: ChatGPT account
account-actions.description: Run a bridge on this phone or connect to your PC. Official ChatGPT account sign-in, no API keys.

preview-before-build.name: Preview before placing objects
preview-before-build.description: Generate shows planned centers in green. Keep adds the result; Discard leaves the level unchanged. Actual footprints are checked on Keep.

clear-prompt.name: Clear prompt after sending
clear-prompt.description: Disable to keep the prompt for editing. Reuse copies the last prompt from the current chat.

chat-text-size.name: Chat text size (%)
chat-text-size.description: Reply text size. Close and reopen the panel after changing.

panel-size.name: Panel size (%)
panel-size.description: Compact centered window size. Keeps the editor visible around the panel.
